decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is still mentioned after two years and fits the firm's organic expansion strategy, and keeping a close line extension on the market costs little, so the option is still worth holding.

The premium sharing snack went from a page of its own to a mere mention, which hints at weaker prominence, but it was expanded into a poultry variant and is cheap to carry, so its value is not yet clearly resolved.
Launched only in 2024 with a page of its own, the organic boiled pork sausage's prospects are still uncertain and it supports the organic direction, so the option should be kept open.
The organic thinly sliced chicken breast is a recent launch with two variants and active promotion, so uncertainty has not yet resolved against it and holding it costs little.
The organic herb-coated salami is new, close to the core salami competence and cheap to keep on the market, so management retains the option while results come in.
